recipe.title: Gourmet Garlic Butter Vegan Shrimp Scampi
recipe.description: A classic Italian-inspired scampi featuring tender plant-based shrimp tossed in a velvety roasted garlic, white wine, and lemon sauce served over al dente linguine.

ingredients.item: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the linguine and cook according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup of starchy pasta water, then drain the pasta.

While the pasta cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the plant-based shrimp and sear for 3 to 4 minutes per side until warm and lightly golden. Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.

In the same skillet, reduce heat to low and add the remaining olive oil along with 1 tablespoon of vegan butter. Add the minced garlic and red pepper flakes, sautéing gently for 1 to 2 minutes until sweet and fragrant without browning.
Pour in the dry white wine and lemon juice, turning the heat up to medium to simmer. Let the liquid reduce by half, about 4 to 5 minutes.
Whisk in the remaining 2 tablespoons of cold vegan butter to emulsify the sauce into a glossy consistency. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

Add the cooked linguine and seared vegetarian shrimp to the skillet. Toss continuously for 2 minutes to allow the pasta to absorb the garlic sauce, adding reserved pasta water 1 tablespoon at a time if needed.
Remove from heat, fold in the lemon zest and fresh chopped parsley, and serve immediately in warm pasta bowls.

tips: Look for konjac-based or soy-protein vegetarian shrimp in asian markets or health food stores for the best realistic texture.
Do not let the garlic brown during cooking, as scorched garlic becomes bitter and ruins the delicate emulsion sauce.
